title: Duty to administer trust.
partHeading: PART VIII. DUTIES AND POWERS OF TRUSTEE
bodyText: Upon acceptance of a trusteeship, the trustee shall administer the trust in good faith, in accordance with its terms and purposes and the interests of the beneficiaries, and in accordance with this chapter.
bodyHtml:
PART VIII.  DUTIES AND POWERS OF TRUSTEE

 

     [§554D-801]  Duty to administer trust.  Upon acceptance of a trusteeship, the trustee shall administer the trust in good faith, in accordance with its terms and purposes and the interests of the beneficiaries, and in accordance with this chapter. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
